# state reference frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stateReferenceFrame`](gmeow-stateReferenceFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stateReferenceFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The coordinate reference frame in which this location state's pose and velocity are expressed. Functional: a state is expressed in exactly one frame; nested-frame transformations (e.g. satellite relative to ship) are computed by the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to declare the single frame in which a location state's pose and velocity are expressed; functional, a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasReferenceFrame`](gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it (the frame gate requires it) and avoid asserting nested-frame transforms as triples (solver-layer, [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:stateReferenceFrame`](gmeow-stateReferenceFrame.md); relative-frame transforms are computed by the solver.
